title: Nnamulondo Eyatambula mu Kaseera Katono
intro: Omusajja ow’obuyinza obw’ekitalo yafuga obwakabaka obwali bugagga obwali buweereddwa omukisa n’obugagga obusukkiridde. Bwe wabaawo okusoomoozebwa kwe yali tasuubira, omufuzi ono teyayolekagana na kugezesebwa kwa bitala wabula okw’amagezi n’okukkiriza. Ekyo ekyali kibikkulwa kyandiviiriddeko okuva ku ntikko y’obuyinza bw’ensi okutuuka ku nkyukakyuka ey’amaanyi ey’omutima.
clues: Nafuga obwakabaka obwali buweereddwa omukisa n’obugagga n’okukulaakulana okusukkiridde okulowooza
Nnali kabaka ow’amaanyi eyafuna ebbaluwa enzirugavu ng’eyagala okugondera
Abakulu bange bampabula ku ky’okulwana oba okutabagana ne kabaka ono ow’ewala
Nasitula n’ebirabo eby’ekitalo okusisinkana kabaka ono ow’ewala nze kennyini
Entebe yange ey’obwakabaka yaleetebwa mu nsi ey’ewala mu kaseera katono, nga sinnadda
Bwe nayingira olubiri nga wansi luweweevu ng’endabirwamu, nnasembayo okulangirira okugondera Allah

outcome.answer: Okugondera Allah ku mabbali ga nabbi

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
